crop.notes: Only the three-line 'Sporting Notes' item at the top of crop-1 is about Allen. The rest is a Sportsman's Park racing notice and 'In the Interests of Irrigation' (Denver reservoir), which fills the rest of crop-1 and crop-2.

ocr.notes: Allen notice transcribed correctly; the rest mostly right with minor errors.

title.suggested: Notice of Free Concerts at Tom Allen's, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice under "Sporting Notes" in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening and only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, December 12, 1896, page 4.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised a free concert every evening ("best of singers only engaged"); he styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Standing saloon notice. Focus primary because the item is entirely about Allen, though only three lines.
